caption: Castello Carlo V and harbor, Monopoli
composition: Seaside fortress and twin-domed cathedral on the porto antico · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The stone Castello Carlo V sits on its rocky point at the left, waves lapping the rocks below. Behind it the white old town climbs the slope, the twin domes of the cathedral crowning the upper right. Blue fishing boats float on the glassy harbor water in the foreground under the clear 08:32 morning sky.
